fullPassage: Teak is among the most prized of the tropical hardwoods. It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture. One problem with harvesting teak is that the wood is very dense, so that when it is first felled and has not been dried it sinks in water. It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless the wood has been dried first.

questions.passage: It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that __________ (require) an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color.
questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

It is a leaf-losing species that __________ (require) an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests.

det.korean: require → requires: 선행사 species(단수)에 수일치하는 주격 관계절 동사.
det.analysis: 주격 관계사 that의 선행사 species(단수) → 단수 동사 requires
det.tip: 선행사 species 단수 → requires

questions.passage: Teak is among __________. It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture. One problem with harvesting teak is that the wood is very dense, so that when it is first felled and has not been dried it sinks in water. It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless the wood has been dried first.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 표현을 [조건]에 따라 영어로 쓰시오.

Teak is among __________.

[조건] (1) hardwoods, prized, the, most, of, the, tropical을 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: the most prized of the tropical hardwoods — 최상급 the most + 형용사 + of + 명사구.
det.analysis: the most prized(최상급) + of + the tropical hardwoods(열대 경재 중). among the most prized = 가장 값진 축에 속함
det.tip: among the most prized of ~ = 가장 ~한 것들 중 하나

questions.wa: the most prized of the tropical hardwoods
accept: the most prized of the tropical hardwoods

questions.passage: Teak is among the most prized of the tropical hardwoods. It is native to India, Thailand, and Vietnam. It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, __________. One problem with harvesting teak is that the wood is very dense, so that when it is first felled and has not been dried it sinks in water. It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless the wood has been dried first.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때, 주어진 단어들을 올바른 순서로 배열하여 빈칸을 채우시오. (영어로, 11단어)
[우리말] 티크는 단단해서, 그것은 선박 제조와 고급 가구를 위한 귀중한 목재가 된다.
[단어] a / and / for / furniture / high-quality / in / it / making / shipbuilding / valued / wood

Teak is strong, __________.

det.korean: making(분사구문) + it(목적어) + a valued wood(목적보어) + in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture(수식구).
det.analysis: 분사구문 making + 5형식(it=목적어, a valued wood=목적보어) + 전치사구 in/for 병렬
det.tip: making it + 명사구 + in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture

questions.wa: making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture
accept: making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture

It is a leaf-losing species that requires an annual dry season, so it is not found in the true rainforests. The wood of teak is particularly attractive, having a golden or reddish brown color. Teak is strong, making it a valued wood in shipbuilding and for high-quality furniture. questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 표현을 [조건]에 따라 영어로 쓰시오.

It cannot be moved out of forests by floating down rivers unless __________.

[조건] (1) first, dried, been, the, wood, has를 모두 사용할 것
       (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: the wood has been dried first — unless 조건절, 현재완료 수동(has been dried) + first.
det.analysis: unless + 주어(the wood) + 현재완료 수동(has been dried) + first(먼저). 먼저 건조되지 않으면 운반 불가
det.tip: unless the wood has been dried first = 먼저 건조되지 않으면
